Subject: RE: Dec 4 payout: netted refund vs gross settlement (file attached)

Thanks Marissa — I pulled the Novanet CSV and matched it to our AR extract. Initial findings:

- The $48,250.00 netting maps to a refund that was processed July 2026 (INV-84721). The refund was posted as a reduction to revenue at the time (we used immediate revenue reduction).
- Novanet has netted the merchant settlement prior to remit (i.e., cash never hit bank for that amount, it was deducted at settlement). Our cash receipts file shows the Dec 4 ACH net amount which therefore appears short by $48,250 versus gross settlements + unapplied credits.
- Resulting condition: We have a $48,250 unapplied credit on AR and a matching short in cash-to-GL.

Proposed corrective action (draft JE attached: journal_entry_draft.docx):
1) Debit: Suspense/Clearing Account (1420) $48,250.00
2) Credit: Unearned Refund Liability / Revenue Reclass (4002) $48,250.00

Rationale: Because the vendor netted the refund at settlement (not as a separate reversal), we need to move the revenue reduction to a clearing account that will be cleared when Novanet confirms the netting reference and we can match cash traces. This avoids restating recognized revenue in prior periods; it's a reclassification to clearing until we get final settlement evidence.

Action items and owners:
- Lauren: post JE after Rishi approval (target: 12/09 EOD).
- Aditya: validate tax/VAT impact on a reclassification (any VAT reclaimed?) — attach comments in the workbook.
- Naomi: supply refund evidence (customer agreement, refund ticket, refund ID) by EOD 12/08.
- Evelyn: create FIN-4529 in Jira and upload reconciliations and Novanet audit pack.

I attached a working reconciliation workbook (reconciliation_workbook_FIN-4529.xlsx) with a tab for tax impact and a draft JE. Please review and flag if you think we should do a direct revenue reversal instead of the clearing approach.

-Lauren

Please proceed with the JE posting on 12/09 as proposed and keep me posted on confirmation from Novanet. Also: do not issue any customer-facing credits or adjustments until cash traces are matched.
